commit_message:
[Util] Filter non-returning region terminators

Explorer::walkReturnOps treated every block terminator in a region branch
operation as a return to the parent. For scf.while, this included the
after-region yield that branches back to the before region, causing
loop-carried values to contribute to result affinities.

Skip terminators that do not implement the region branch terminator
interface, as well as region branch terminators that cannot branch to the
parent operation.

Fixes #24787
